Lesotho
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Berlin.
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Embassy of Kingdom of Lesotho, Berlinu:
Address: Kurfurstenstrasse 84, 10787 BerlinTel: +49 171 3067 789 +49 171 3070 340 +49 171 3069 087Web: www.lesothoembassy.de/contacts/default.php
Citizens of the Kingdom of Lesotho are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
